name: Feng mo ying xiang
source:
Asahi Nanyuan and the Film Club are riding high after an award win – but the joy is short-lived when Kinako, their cat, suddenly goes missing.

[From [url=https://sagisawayukiho.itch.io/enchanted]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朝日南苑和电影俱乐部在获奖后欣喜若狂，但当他们的猫Kinako突然失踪时，这种喜悦是短暂的。

[来自[url=https://sagisawayukiho.itch.io/enchanted]Itch.io[/url]]
